title: FAQ: Silver Plus Account
summary: This document covers the Silver Plus Account’s tiered APY (Tier 1: 3.0%, Tier 2: 4.5%), the $2,500 minimum balance requirement, and the $8.00 monthly maintenance fee if balance falls below $2,500. It also confirms built-in savings goals tracking.
